observation: Top view: the assembled set reads as one Sun. Twenty-four lane tiles fan from the raised orange centre bar to one exact circular arc at the rim, strictly alternating light and dark all the way round, with the constant orange margin at every boundary and no notch or bay cut into any tile end. Outside that arc stand 32 separate flames on the disc's own edge circle, parted by open ground, broad at the root and narrowing to small blunt caps. They lean both ways in short irregular runs: neighbouring pairs repeatedly splay apart into a V or lean toward each other, and the long flames no longer rake together. Thirty counters sit in the opening position, fifteen cream and fifteen dark brown, in groups of 2, 5, 3 and 5 per side, each on its own lane at a radial station, none overlapping a neighbouring tile, none on a flame, a bank tick or the bar. The four engraved bank ticks are on the bar top. Iso view: every counter sits flat on its tile with clear air around it, the tiles sit proud of the body, the bar top is the highest plane and is unobstructed, the flame tops ramp down toward the rim and the whole part sits flat. Front view: the stack reads deck, tile, bar, with one counter layer above the tile tops; nothing floats and nothing leans. Fifty-five separate solids, nothing fused, no visible intersection, no missing, extra, misplaced or wrongly oriented part.
